
↑ 2. File-Based Storage
     Persist data to files on disk in formats like JSON, CSV, or plain text. Offers
     a good balance between simplicity and data persistence. Suitable for small to
     medium datasets. Slower than in-memory but data survives restarts.
  3. Database
     Use a SQL or NoSQL database for data storage. Provides robust persistence,
     advanced querying capabilities, transaction support, and excellent scalability.
     More complex setup but handles large datasets and concurrent access reliably.
     Production-grade approach.
❯ 4. Mixed approach
